model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the changes in the absolute mean of the hidden state across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios: the hidden state mean before the gate, after the gate, and the baseline. 

The X-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, marked at intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and represents the absolute mean value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, marked at intervals of 1. 

The graph contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" with an average value of 0.71, an orange dotted line representing the "hidden state mean after gate" with an average value of 0.05, and a green solid line representing the "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average value of 0.04. 

The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.1 on the Y-axis at layer 0 and remains relatively stable until layer 10, where it begins to fluctuate slightly, with a slight increase to around 0.3 at layer 12. It then remains steady until layer 17, after which it increases more sharply, reaching approximately 1 at layer 20 and surging to around 4.5 by layer 23. The orange dotted line remains relatively flat and close to 0 throughout, starting at around 0.01 at layer 0 and ending at approximately 0.03 at layer 23. The green solid line is nearly indistinguishable from the orange dotted line, also remaining close to 0, starting at around 0 and ending at approximately 0.03 at layer 23. 

Overall, the graph effectively visualizes the differences in the absolute mean of the hidden state across the three scenarios, with the "hidden state mean before gate" showing a significant increase towards the higher layers, while the other two lines remain relatively stable and close to 0.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图展示了三个不同类别的“隐状态均值”随层数变化的趋势。图表的x轴标记为“层”，其数值范围从0到24，刻度间隔为5，类型为数值线性刻度。y轴标记为“绝对均值”，数值范围从0到4，刻度间隔为1，也属于数值线性刻度。图表中展示了三条线，分别代表“门控前的隐状态均值”（蓝色虚线）、“门控后的隐状态均值”（橙色点线）和“基线的隐状态均值”（绿色实线）。蓝色的“门控前”线起始于大约0.1，随后在第1层和第3层之间上升至约0.2，并在第3层和第17层之间在0.2左右波动，然后从第17层的0.3上升至第20层的0.9，最后在第24层急剧上升至4.4。“门控后”和“基线”的线条几乎重叠，分别保持在0.05和0.04附近，且在整个x轴数值范围内保持相对稳定。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden state means across different layers. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the absolute mean, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, and tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate" with an average value of 0.71, an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate" with an average value of 0.05, and a green dashed line representing "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average value of 0.04. The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.08 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.2 until layer 10, and then increases to 0.45 at layer 17, followed by a sharp rise to 4.4 at layer 23. The orange dotted line begins at 0.02 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.04 until layer 12, and then gradually increases to 0.08 at layer 23. The green dashed line starts at 0.01 at layer 0 and remains relatively stable around 0.04 across all layers.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across various layers, comparing three distinct metrics. The x-axis represents the "Layer", ranging from 0 to 23 with intervals of 5, while the y-axis denotes the "Abs Mean" on a linear scale from 0 to 4. Three lines are plotted: "hidden state mean before gate" (blue dashed line), "hidden state mean after gate" (orange dotted line), and "hidden state mean of baseline" (green solid line). The "hidden state mean before gate" starts at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.2 until layer 10, and then gradually increases to 0.4 at layer 18, before rising sharply to 1 at layer 21 and further to around 4.5 at layer 23. The "hidden state mean after gate" and "hidden state mean of baseline" both begin near 0 and remain relatively constant, with the former at approximately 0.05 and the latter at around 0.04 across all layers, with both lines largely overlapping throughout.
